features.label: Action silhouettes
features.explanation: Keep the original action and perspective and simplify subjects into clear, forceful silhouettes
features.evidence: Qiao Feng’s and Zhou Botong’s front palms and Yang Guo’s sword tip are greatly enlarged in the foreground. Torsos tilt diagonally, while rocks underfoot and distant mountains on the right establish layers from front to back. This strong camera-like perspective is an important sign of the group’s fusion with modern action illustration. Do not treat every instance of exaggerated perspective as a fixed convention of traditional ukiyo-e.
features.zh: 保持原动作与透视，将主体概括为清楚有力的剪影
features.en: Keep the original action and perspective and simplify subjects into clear, forceful silhouettes

features.label: Flowing ink lines
features.explanation: Use dark contours and fine lines following the action to organize forms
features.evidence: Hair, folds, white fabric ribbons, red sashes, bamboo leaves and foam rotate around the figures together. Long curves connect broad dark areas, while short incised-looking lines explain local forms. Good directional flow serves the figure’s action first and decoration second. Once lines become equally dense everywhere, small details scatter the eye.
features.zh: 用深色轮廓与顺着动作流向的细线组织形体
features.en: Use dark contours and fine lines following the action to organize forms

features.label: Beige, indigo and brick red
features.explanation: Use a limited palette of beige, ink black, deep indigo and a little brick red
features.evidence: Dark outlines define sleeves, palm edges, blades and wave crests. Beige paper-like ground, ink black, deep indigo and a little brick red establish the broad color relationships; Huang Yaoshi’s image adds gray-green and red-pink. Local hatching and shading occur, but major forms should first read through contours and color masses, without centering realistic highlights or metallic reflections.
features.zh: 以米黄、墨黑、深靛蓝与少量砖红形成有限配色
features.en: Use a limited palette of beige, ink black, deep indigo and a little brick red

features.label: Flat color and hatching
features.explanation: Use mostly flat color with local hatching to describe volume, without aiming for naturalistic highlights
features.evidence: Dark outlines define sleeves, palm edges, blades and wave crests. Beige paper-like ground, ink black, deep indigo and a little brick red establish the broad color relationships; Huang Yaoshi’s image adds gray-green and red-pink. Local hatching and shading occur, but major forms should first read through contours and color masses, without centering realistic highlights or metallic reflections.
features.zh: 以平涂为主，局部排线说明体积，不追求写实高光
features.en: Use mostly flat color with local hatching to describe volume, without aiming for naturalistic highlights

features.label: Concentrated direction
features.explanation: Unify the main direction of action within the original composition and make secondary details serve the subject
features.evidence: A long vermilion frame at upper right, a small ivory cartouche beside it and red seals create a consistent layout, like a character atlas. Text identifies characters rather than functioning only as ornament. All inscriptions and seals in the original references are retained. Another poster can borrow this hierarchy, but names, techniques and signatures should be checked first; text is best added during layout.
features.zh: 在原构图中统一主动作方向，让次要细节服从主体
features.en: Unify the main direction of action within the original composition and make secondary details serve the subject

features.label: Restrained aged-paper effect
features.explanation: Use restrained aged-paper grain, reducing cracks on faces, hands and key objects
features.evidence: Beige ground, mottled ink areas, fine cracks and grain make the images appear aged. Here cracks even extend across skin, clothing and sky, creating a strong effect over the entire surface. This can unify the series, but can also make skin look like stone and blades like rocks. Texture should be secondary, leaving faces, hands and important objects clearer. Actual woodblock-printing technique cannot be established from texture alone.
features.zh: 加入适度旧纸颗粒，在脸、手和主要物件上减弱裂纹
features.en: Use restrained aged-paper grain, reducing cracks on faces, hands and key objects

features.label: Forceful narrative
features.explanation: Create a forceful, tense image with clear narrative
features.evidence: Consistent frames, paper color, cartouches and sashes make the four images distinctive as a group; Huang Yaoshi’s flute and cool green robe provide necessary variation. Qiao Feng’s and Zhou Botong’s foreground palms, and all four figures’ flowing hair and red sashes, remain close to the same action template. A new series can retain a consistent layout while changing the main action, silhouettes and open space, rather than simply replacing names and background symbols.
features.zh: 营造有力、紧张且叙事清楚的画面气质
features.en: Create a forceful, tense image with clear narrative

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
